android.permission.CAMERA.name: Camera Access
android.permission.CAMERA.description: Allows the app to capture images and videos using the device camera.

android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.name: Precise Location
android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION.description: Allows the app to access precise geographic coordinates using GPS and cellular data.

android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.name: Approximate Location
android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATIO.description: Allows the app to access approximate location derived from network sources.

android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.name: Read Contacts
android.permission.READ_CONTACTS.description: Allows the app to read data about your contacts stored on your device.

android.permission.READ_SMS.name: Read SMS Messages
android.permission.READ_SMS.description: Allows the app to read SMS messages, including 2FA authentication codes.

android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.name: Microphone Access
android.permission.RECORD_AUDIO.description: Allows the app to record audio using the device microphone.

android.permission.INTERNET.name: Full Network Access
android.permission.INTERNET.description: Allows the app to create network sockets and use custom network protocols.
